hook_line: INDIANS CAN NOW BOOK BURJ KHALIFA, SENTOSA TICKETS ONLINE USING UPI

hook_stat.sub: Now accept UPI, with Uzbekistan set to become the 11th

stats.label: UPI-based ticket booking for the Eiffel Tower in France was launched
At the Top, Burj Khalifa is the first attraction in the UAE to implement UPI for e-commerce

diaspora_bullets: Travellers can pay for these bookings from a UPI app instead of relying only on an international card
In Singapore the facility covers Universal Studios Singapore, the Singapore Oceanarium and Adventure Cove Waterpark
news_summary: Indian travellers can now use UPI apps to book online tickets for At the Top, Burj Khalifa in Dubai and for Resorts World Sentosa attractions in Singapore, the Finance Ministry said on October 30.
payoff: UPI is now accepted in 10 countries, and Uzbekistan is set to become the 11th.
